nodes.question: What aspects of solar photovoltaic technology and socio-economic factors are examined in the Future of Solar Photovoltaic report by IRENA?
nodes.answer: The IRENA report delves into the deployment, investment, technology, grid integration, and socio-economic aspects of solar photovoltaic technology, providing a comprehensive overview of the future of this renewable energy source.
